source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Opposite sides is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Which side lengths can be inferred in a parallelogram?' is answered as opposite sides rather than parallelogram.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Opposite sides is what produces parallelogram, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Which side lengths can be inferred in a parallelogram?.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: parallelogram is settled by running 'What extra diagonal condition turns the rectangle diagonal': For a square, the diagonals are equal, bisect each other, meet at right angles, and bisect — on the item about Which side lengths can be inferred in a parallelogram?.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Parallelogram is computed by squaring opposite sides and leaving parallelogram linear, so the written value is 17 — on the item about Which side lengths can be inferred in a parallelogram?.

intelligence.enrichment: The opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal.
